title: Kalanchoe pinnata(Cathedral Bells/Miracle Leaf - 2x Mini Plug Plants Houseplant
description:
Kalanchoe pinnata, also known as Cathedral Bells, Miracle Leaf, Life Plant, or Goethe Plant, is a beautiful tender succulent from Madagascar. It features sturdy stems, light-green scalloped leaves that produce baby plantlets along the edges, and striking bell-shaped purplish flowers.


  Care:
 

   Light:
  
  Prefers full sun
 

   Soil:
  
  Well-draining cactus mix
 

   Watering:
  
  Allow soil to dry out between watering
 

   Temperature:
  
  Keep above 5–10°C
 

   Propagation:
  
  Easily grows from leaf-edge plantlets
 

   Pests:
  
  Treat aphids, spider mites, or mealybugs with neem oil
 

 Ideal as an ornamental houseplant. You will receive
 
  2 healthy mini plug plants
 
 ready to pot and grow.
